title: AlterContacts
lede: AlterContacts is an iPhone assistant for client-facing professionals: you speak about a meeting and it files the details to the right client, tracks commitments and drafts the follow-up.

points: A spoken recap or a full meeting recording is attached to the right client and turned into tasks.
New client profiles are filled in from LinkedIn, the web and a connected Gmail and calendar.
A morning view lists who needs attention that day and why, including renewals and personal milestones.
When a follow-up is due it drafts the message, which the user edits and approves before it goes.
The team says it interviewed 26 financial advisors before building; commenters are asking for Android, desktop and an MCP server.

sections.text: Financial advisors, brokers, consultants, property agents and salespeople who manage many client relationships and dislike CRM data entry.
The launch comment mentions a Pro plan and offers a free month of it with the code PRODUCTHUNT; no prices are given.
